{{Quote|I smell fear, and it smells good.|Trench|audio=ISmellFear-CaM.flac|<ref name="CatandMouse" />}}
[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] '''Trench''', a [[Harch/Legends|Harch]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], was a feared and legendary [[Commander/Legends|commander]] for the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], whose extensive [[Navy/Legends|naval]] career spanned several [[Time/Legends|decades]]. A veteran of countless conflicts, Trench gained fame during the [[Andoan Wars/Legends|Andoan Wars]], first defending his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Secundus Ando/Legends|Secundus Ando]] and then spearheading a counteroffensive against the [[Andoan Free Colonies/Legends|Andoan Free Colonies]]. A master strategist, he became known as [[Ando/Legends|Ando's]] greatest military leader and accumulated an impressive record, eventually coming to serve the Corporate Alliance. His tactics were ruthlessly efficient, and he became feared by his enemies, whether they were [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] or veteran [[Officer/Legends|officers]] from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[34 BBY/Legends|34 BBY]], Trench masterminded the Alliance's [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] of the [[Malastare Narrows/Legends|Malastare Narrows]] and, in the ensuing [[Battle of Malastare Narrows/Legends|Battle of Malastare Narrows]], nearly [[Space warfare/Legends|eradicated]] an entire Republic-backed [[Fleet/Legends|task force]] under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]]. When [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-led reinforcements arrived, Trench's [[Trench's flagship/Legends|flagship]] was destroyed and the admiral himself presumed [[Death/Legends|dead]], but he survived thanks to a [[Environment suit/Legends|pressure suit]] and his natural toughness as a Harch.

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Trench became a key member of the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]], being one of the Confederacy's most experienced admirals. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], he led the [[Christophsis blockade/Legends|Confederate blockade]] of [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]] from the [[Dreadnaught/Legends|dreadnaught]] [[Invincible/Legends|''Invincible'']], which brought him into [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|conflict]] with a Republic [[Battle group/Legends|battle group]] commanded by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. When Skywalker and Trench's old rival, Wullf Yularen, attempted to use an experimental [[Stealth ship/Legends|stealth ship]] to breach the blockade, Trench began a deadly game of cat and mouse with them. He was outsmarted when Skywalker exploited his overconfidence, crashing several [[Tracking torpedo/Legends|tracking torpedoes]] into the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of the ''Invincible''. Trench managed to survive, albeit with partial [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] reconstruction, and commanded Separatist forces at the [[Battle of Ringo Vinda/Legends|Battle of Ringo Vinda]] of [[20 BBY/Legends|19.1 BBY]].

==Biography==
===Early career===
====The Andoan Wars====
[[File:AdmiralTrench-EGTW.jpg|thumb|right|Admiral Trench became a highly decorated naval commander during the late Republic Era.]]
Trench was born on [[Secundus Ando/Legends|Secundus Ando]] [[221 BBY|over two hundred years]] before the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and began a military career. Trench made his reputation during the [[Andoan Wars/Legends|Andoan Wars]] of [[57 BBY/Legends|57]]&ndash;[[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]]. During that war, Trench fought against the [[Andoan Free Colonies/Legends|Andoan Free Colonies]] when his homeworld allied with the [[Spiverelda/Legends|Spiverelda]], the government of [[Ando/Legends|Ando]]. Trench defended [[Secundus Ando/Legends|Secundus Ando]] from raiders from the Free Colonies and lead counter-raids up the [[Horos Spine]] to [[Andosha II|Andosha]]. By the time the war ended at the [[Battle of Raquish]] in 39 BBY, Trench came out as Ando's greatest military leader, besting his enemies numerous times during the Andoan Wars.<ref name="Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

However, Trench's victory was a pyrrhic one: the violence and ruthlessness he had displayed at the Battle of Raquish convinced the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to intervene and separate the two sides. The Free Colonies were saved and a [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial fleet]] enforced the [[Ando Demilitarization Observation Group|demilitarization]] of the [[Lambda sector/Legends|Lambda sector]]. The sudden defeat radicalized both the Andoan leadership and Trench.<ref name="Essential Guide to Warfare" />

====The Battle of Malastare Narrows====
{{Quote|A corporate fleet was blockading Malastare, a fleet led by Trench.|Wullf Yularen|audio=AFleetLedByTrench-CaM.flac|<ref name="CatandMouse" />}}
[[File:TrenchFile-CatAndMouse.png|250px|thumb|left|Admiral Trench's military record, his emblem included]]
In the decade before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Trench served the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]] as a mercenary, helping it destroy pirate bases at [[Ord Namurt]], [[Engira]], and seized the [[Kurosti merchant fleet]] in a daring raid at [[Prospera Jang]]. In [[34 BBY/Legends|34 BBY]] Trench masterminded a battle that would later become known as the [[Battle of Malastare Narrows/Legends|Battle of Malastare Narrows]].<ref name="Essential Guide to Warfare" /><ref name="CatandMouse" /><ref name="TCWUK6.8">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.8|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Comic 6.8]], in Yularen's profile</ref> It was here that he made himself a part of military history. The Corporate Alliance<ref name="TCWNW" /> blockaded the planet [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] in an effort to force a settlement in a dispute over fuel allocations and Trench was given command of the corporate fleet.<ref name="Essential Guide to Warfare" />

Trench's force was engaged in the [[Malastare Narrows/Legends|Malastare Narrows]] by a force of Republic-backed [[Privateer/Legends|privateers]]. During the battle, Trench's presence and action left a lasting memory to all those who were involved, including a young [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]], who commanded a fleet at that time, though was formally present as a Republic observer. Many lives were lost and many ships were torn apart by the fleet of the Harch admiral. However, the leadership of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kep-She/Legends|Kep-She]] ensured that the battle ended with Trench's ship being vaporized and the Corporate Alliance fleet forced to retreat. Trench was assumed to have gone down with the destroyed vessel, but in fact survived thanks to a pressure suit of [[Andoan mineral-fish]] armor and his own tough Harch hide.<ref name="Essential Guide to Warfare" />

In [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]], the [[Spiverelda/Legends|Spiverelda]] was one of the first governments to declare for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], and Ando and Trench's homeworld [[Ando separation|seceded]] from the Republic. The Corporate Alliance later joined the Separatists as well, and more than a decade after his disappearance, Trench resurfaced during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] at the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Blockade of Christophsis]] in command of the Separatist fleet.<ref name="CatandMouse" />

===Clone Wars===
====The Blockade of Christophsis====
{{Quote|Our orders are to blockade, not chase. I have won this round.|Trench|audio=IHaveWonThisRound-CaM.flac|<ref name="CatandMouse" />}}
[[File:Trench_armada.png|thumb|right|250px|Trench in charge of his fleet]]
During the start of the Clone Wars,<ref name="TCWnovel">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]]</ref> the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] sent a relief effort for the people of [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]]. This mission to send aid to the [[Christophsian/Legends|Christophsians]] was led by [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] from [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. However, the planet had fallen under attack from Admiral Trench and his command units.<ref name="CatandMouse" />

Trench's first priority was to cut off any supplies that were headed to the relief effort on the planet below. Commanding his fleet from his war-painted [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|Separatist dreadnaught]] that had been dubbed the [[Invincible/Legends|''Invincible'']], the massive fire power of his cruiser allowed the Admiral to cripple any attempt by incoming supply ships to get to the surface.<ref name="CatandMouse" />

Such an attempt was made by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and the cruisers under his command. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were met with suppressive fire from Trench's destroyer and were forced to retreat behind the [[Christophsis's moon/Legends|moon]] of Christophsis. While the Jedi retreated and regrouped, Trench felt that he had won this round. His [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|tactical droid]] was puzzled and asked Trench if they should pursue. The Admiral instead ordered his troops not to follow the enemy, as per the commands he was issued by higher authority; after which, Trench commanded his droids to recycle the ship's shields and allow the cannons to recharge to full power. The Admiral, satisfied with the proceedings, seated himself at the bridge and awaited for the return of the enemy ships.<ref name="CatandMouse" />

However, Trench's old adversary from Malastare Narrows, Wullf Yularen, was also present at Christophsis. After recognizing Trench's [[Trench's crest/Legends|distinctive insignia]] painted on his flagship, Yularen studied everything [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]] had gathered on the Admiral's tactics, allowing him to plan a counter-attack.<ref name="Essential Guide to Warfare" /> This came in the form of a [[Stealth ship/Legends|stealth ship]], piloted by Anakin Skywalker himself and Admiral Yularen. Unaware of the existence and capabilities of the cloaked ship, Trench became impatient and ordered a squadron of [[Hyena-class bomber/Legends|''Hyena''-class bombers]] to attack the surface, particularly the command center of Bail Organa. The bombing was planned by Trench to draw the Republic "cowards", as the Harch admiral viewed his adversaries, out of hiding.<ref name="CatandMouse" />

Although the stealth ship was undetected by the Admiral, Trench suspected that there was something odd going on. His suspicions proved correct, when Skywalker's ship presented itself and fired its torpedoes at Trench's cruiser. This move proved the Admiral's suspicions to be true; however, the maneuver had little effect and Skywalker failed to do any damage. Admiral Trench responded quickly and raised his ship's thermal shields to prevent his bridge being destroyed by the Republic's sneak attack. Angered by this act of foolishness, Trench countered by firing his own torpedoes at the stealth ship. Skywalker managed evade the torpedoes by ordering flares shot in four different directions. As a result of the successful trick, Skywalker saved himself and his crew for the moment.<ref name="CatandMouse" />

After the engagement, the stealth ship went into hiding again. Unsure of where the targeted ship was, the furious Admiral fired a spread of lasers, but to no avail, as Skywalker managed to navigate the "wave" of laser fire. Seeing how the short skirmish played out, Trench was now sure that he was not dealing with mere clone pilots, but with a Jedi. He made an open-frequency transmission on the [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] channel so that he could demonstrate himself to his adversaries. Threatening the crew of the stealth ship and advising them to retreat while they still could, Trench ended the transmission with a warning that he would be their doom.<ref name="CatandMouse" />

====The final stand====
{{Quote|Turn back now, retreat while you can, for I am your ''doom''.|Trench to Anakin Skywalker and his crew|audio=AdmiralDoom-CaM.flac|<ref name="CatandMouse" />}}
[[File:Trench_2.png|thumb|left|250px|Admiral Trench accepting his fate]]
Having displayed himself to his enemies, he awaited the next Republic attack. Trench pointed out that the Jedi could have easily passed the blockade, but rather decided to attack. This gave the Admiral a sense of what the Jedi was capable of and what kind of enemy he was facing. Trench prepared himself for the Jedi's inevitable second offensive. Eventually the cloaked vessel revealed itself, but this time, the crew had knowledge of Trench's tactics when dealing with ship cloaking devices. Trench tracked the magnetic signatures of ships so that he could follow and destroy them. The stealth ship opened fire upon Trench's flagship (the attack itself was only a diversion) and Skywalker's ship again cloaked itself. Trench then locked on to the ship's magnetic signature and ordered his tactical droid to fire a torpedo at the source of the signature on his command. However, he would forced to lower his shields to do so and the droid advised that such a maneuver would be unwise. In a moment of compulsive anger (and against his droid's advice), Trench gave the order and the torpedoes were launched.<ref name="CatandMouse" />

This had been the moment Skywalker was waiting for. The stealth ship, with torpedoes on its tail, turned around and headed towards the bridge of Trench's command ship. Surprised by the bold attack, the Admiral ordered the shields to be raised, but Trench's tactical droid reported that the shields were still recharging and the ship was left defenseless. Trench was caught off-guard and, seeing the Republic ship speeding towards him, the Admiral was unsure of what to do or how to react. Accepting his defeat, he closed his six eyes and awaited his demise. The stealth ship narrowly missed Trench's own vessel and the torpedoes slammed straight into the bridge, destroying Trench's flagship and bringing chaos to the blockade. Trench was believed to be dead after the skirmish had ended,<ref name="CatandMouse" /> though Yularen did not accept that his old adversary had been killed.<ref name="Essential Guide to Warfare" />

====Ringo Vinda====
At some point after the battle of Christophsis, it was revealed that Admiral Trench survived. His left arms, left eye, one of his chelicerae, and part of his head had received cybernetic replacements, however. Trench was in command of the Separatist forces at [[Ringo Vinda/Legends|Ringo Vinda]], and it was he who discovered the strange behavior of Tup. Trench was able to avert the premature discovery of Order 66 by informing Count Dooku of the clone's bizarre actions.<ref name="New Direction" />
After this, Trench orchestrated a successful attack on the [[Unidentified transport shuttle (Ringo Vinda)/Legends|shuttle]] that transporting Tup to Kamino for further examination. The clone trooper was captured by [[Super battle droid rocket trooper/Legends|super battle droid rocket troopers]] and brought to the Harch Admiral to present to Count Dooku.
[[File:Trench_presents_Tup.png|thumb|right|250px|Admiral Trench presents Tup to Count Dooku]]

The Sith Lord congratulated the Admiral on his success and ordered Trench to have Tup sent to him. Trench complied and tasked his [[Super tactical droid/Legends|super tactical droid]] [[Kraken/Legends|Kraken]] to escort the Clone personally to Count Dooku's location. The mission failed, however, and Tup was recaptured by Republic forces. The Republic fleet withdrew from Ringo Vinda several days later.

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|We need to add some pressure on those who are sent to rescue our enemies on Christophsis. Send the ''Hyena''-bombers to hit senator Organa on the surface. That should draw those cowards out from behind the moon.|Trench applying his tactics against the Republic|audio=TrenchAddsPressure.flac|<ref name="CatandMouse" />}}
[[File:TrenchPointing-CatAndMouse.png|250px|thumb|left|Admiral Trench takes command]]
Trench was an admiral who held no mercy or remorse toward his adversaries, which in turn made him a terror to all those who came across him and his fleet. He was a military genius and his tactics and maneuvers on the battlefield made him responsible for the destruction of many [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|fleets]].<ref name="CatandMouse" /> Two of his war trophies included the battle cruiser ''The Righteous'' and the frigate ''Swift Return''.<ref name="CatandMouse" /><ref name="EPguide2x16">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode216.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Cat and Mouse}}</ref> His genius was also evident in his method of hunting cloaked ships, which was recorded in a intelligence record, which was studied during the blockade of Christophsis by Admiral Yularen.<ref name="CatandMouse" />

Admiral Trench had a distinctive [[Trench's crest/Legends|crest]], resembling his face, emblazoned on all of his ships.<ref name="CatandMouse" />

Having won many victories in war, Trench had developed an overconfident personality and prided himself on always being one step ahead of his opponents. However, this overconfidence nearly led to his own demise. Even when his death appeared eminent, Trench did not panic or show distress; he simply accepted his fate.<ref name="CatandMouse" />

==Equipment==
===Trench's first ship===
{{Main|Trench's flagship/Legends}}
This ship was present at the [[Battle of Malastare Narrows/Legends|Battle of Malastare Narrows]], where it was commanded by Admiral Trench. It managed to keep [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] blockaded until it was destroyed by a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-led task force. Trench himself was believed to have gone down with this ship; however, this information was later proven false.

===The ''Invincible''===
{{Main|Invincible/Legends}}
[[File:Invincible-TCWs2BR3.png|thumb|right|250px|The ''Invincible'']]The ''Invincible'' served as the Harch Admiral's flagship at the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]]. It offered a great range of attacks and a heavy defense of the blockade itself. That was due to the ship being very well-equipped with deflector shields and thermal shields, which offered a powerful defense, allowing the vessel to emerge completely unaffected by hostile fire. The cruiser had the upper hand, but a bad turn of events brought its downfall at the hands of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:CyberneticTrench.png|thumb|left|200px|Trench, after much of his left side was replaced with [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]].]]
Admiral Trench made his appearance in the sixteenth episode of season two, "[[Cat and Mouse]]." The Harch Admiral was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]], who also voices all the clones on the show.<ref name="EPguide2x16" />

Trench's name was originally going to be "Taranch".<ref name="EPguide2x16" /> This would have been a more obvious nod to the name of the arachnid species [[Wikipedia:tarantula|tarantula]], from which his design is derived. Even though the name was dropped, it is still present in the Trench's record, though spelled in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]].<ref name="CatandMouse" />

It should be also noted that Trench's death is not mentioned in the "Cat and Mouse" [[The Clone Wars Episode Guides|episode guide]],<ref name="EPguide2x16" /> which ties in with the discussion between Anakin Skywalker's and Admiral Yularen in the episode about Trench's "first death" and his return.<ref name="CatandMouse" /> Trench's survival was confirmed in a clip shown on [[StarWars.com]], where Trench was shown alive with half his body consisting of cybernetics.<ref name="New Direction" /> Additionally, ''Clone Wars'' writer [[Brent Friedman]] confirmed on his Twitter account that he had written an unproduced episode arc featuring Trench.<ref>{{Twitter|BFree63|status/353962107764609024|Brent Friedman|quote=@Warmustbeend123 One of the arcs I wrote, one you'll sadly never see, featured Trench. But really don't remember if the Order 66 arc does.|archivedate=20200814155155}}</ref>
